verdict.does_not_establish: A validated POSITIVE barrier ranking model. No zero-parameter a-priori model reproduces the intermediate optimum (driven by dispersion/percolation, a formulation-processing variable). Closing that needs >=3 pooled, protocol-controlled formulation->Rc series with dispersion/PVC metadata -- the standing DATA wall.
verdict.finding: On both strict in-class epoxy-amine EIS series the observed within-study barrier ranking is NON-MONOTONE in filler loading (optimum at an intermediate level), so the solids-only and PVC-only hostile nulls (both monotone-in-loading) FAIL to reproduce the ordering (Spearman [0.0, 0.4] ; neither significant). This establishes non-trivial ranking headroom for a barrier-aware score -- a necessary precondition for the module's falsifiable hypothesis -- and quantifies it.
verdict.scope_honesty: Organic epoxy-amine coating-barrier EIS, correct module scope (unlike the substrate-corrosion corr-rate-qspr-v1 diagnostic).
